title: DigiTron
description: Digital scantron system with inexpensive devices for each student.
accolades: Hack The Hammer II - First Place

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A digital scantron system created to eliminate the drawbacks of the traditional paper scantron system. Each student gets an inexpensive scantron device with 5 buttons for ABCDE, a previous button, and a next/submit button. Students connect to the teacher's device with a 4 letter code, complete their test, and press the submit button. The teacher then sees all of the students who are done on the teacher app, along with each student's scores.

sections.title: Advantages
sections.content: DigiTron eliminates messy pencil mark errors, removes the time needed to scan each scantron, and provides a digital copy of all the students' marks instantly. Additionally, the teacher app automatically runs an algorithm to check for any signs of cheating.

sections.title: Technical Implementation
content: Arduino + RF24 + OLED Display - Student Devices

sections.title: Achievement
sections.content: This project won First Place at Hack The Hammer II.
